phase_independence_notes: Phase 2 (FR-8 Principle 9) is independent of Phase 1 (severity bridge) — both can dispatch concurrently after Phase 0.
Phase 3 (FR-9 Blocks-X) depends on Phase 1 bridge content for severity vocabulary but is independent of Phases 2/5/6.
Phase 4 (FR-1 Lens 4) depends on Phase 1 bridge content but is independent of Phases 2/3/5/6.
Phases 5 (FR-6) and 6 (FR-7) parallelize with each other after Phase 2's T2.2 lands (T2.2 → T5.3 is the only cross-phase tie into Phase 5).
Phase 6 (FR-7) is independent of Phases 1/2/3/4/5; can dispatch immediately after Phase 0.
Phase 7 (FR-10 SA-14) depends on Phases 1 + 5 (severity vocab + matrix template + predicate).
Phase 8 (eat-own-dogfood) depends on Phases 5 + 6 + 7 (T7.1 is needed by T8.1's L3 self-audit; T6.1+T6.3 by T8.2).
Phase 9 (rollout) depends on every prior phase.

candidate_parallel_clusters.rationale: Six tasks with no shared writers, only Phase-0 (T0.1/T0.2/T0.3) as predecessors. Maximum-parallelism tier in the run.
Both depend on Phase 1 (T1.1 for T4.2; T0.1+T0.3 for T4.1). Disjoint target files (validate_adr_prescriptions.py vs architecture-audit.md).
Phase 5 finishing tasks parallelize with Phase 6 finishing tasks once T2.2, T5.1, T5.2, T6.1 have landed.
